page.title: Workshop Status
page.lead: Upload the daily workshop morning update, check exactly what will change, then confirm. Nothing changes until you confirm.
page.permLoadError: Your workshop permissions could not be loaded, so upload actions are switched off. Try again.

upload.deniedTitle: You cannot upload the daily workshop file
upload.deniedBody: Uploading the daily Excel needs the Upload daily Excel permission. Ask an administrator to grant it in Console, Access Control.
upload.countryHint: The file is uploaded for one country. Vehicles are matched by asset number within that country only.
upload.countryRequired: Choose the country this file belongs to before choosing the file.
upload.dropTitle: Drop the daily morning update here, or choose a file
upload.dropHint: Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV, up to 10 MB.
upload.emptyBody: Upload the workshop morning update Excel (the job card entry sheet with the open sections and JOB CARD CLOSED DETAILS). You will see every new, changed and released vehicle first. Nothing changes until you press Confirm upload.
upload.loadingRecords: Comparing with the vehicles currently in the workshop...
upload.parseErrorTitle: This file could not be used
upload.recordsErrorTitle: The current workshop list could not be loaded
upload.previewSub: Nothing has been saved yet. Review the changes, then confirm.
upload.unmappedBody: These columns were not recognised and are kept only as raw row data:
upload.duplicateBanner: This file appears to have already been uploaded on {date} by {name}.
upload.duplicateAck: Continue anyway. I have checked this is not the same file again.
upload.duplicateNeedAck: Tick Continue anyway to upload this file again.

emptyTab.new: No new vehicles in this file.
emptyTab.unchanged: No vehicles stayed exactly the same.
emptyTab.removed: No vehicles are released from the active list.
emptyTab.closed: No vehicles are listed only under closed details.
emptyTab.invalid: No invalid rows. Every row has a vehicle number and readable dates.
emptyTab.duplicate: No vehicle appears twice in the open sections.

upload.needConfirmPerm: You can preview this file, but applying it needs the Confirm upload permission.
upload.needUploadPerm: Applying this file needs the Upload daily Excel permission.
upload.dialogNew: Add {count} new vehicles to the active list
upload.dialogChanged: Update the file details of {count} vehicles
upload.dialogRemoved: Release {count} vehicles from the active list
upload.dialogRemovedNote: Released vehicles leave the active list, but their full history is kept and they can be restored if the file was wrong. A person still records the final disposition.
upload.dialogOwnedNote: Stage, delay reason, responsible person and other details maintained in TyrePulse are not changed by an upload.
upload.successBody: Upload {no} was applied for {country}. The active workshop list now has {active} vehicles.
upload.successNoNumber: The upload was applied for {country}. The active workshop list now has {active} vehicles.
upload.staleNotice: Another upload was confirmed while you were reviewing. The comparison has been run again against the latest list. Check the changes and confirm again.
upload.failureKept: Nothing was changed on the server. Your preview is kept, so you can try again.
upload.fallbackError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
